description: Use this when the signed-in user asks to search, filter, or page through their own listings. Returns compact rows. Follow nextCursor until null; a filtered page can be empty and still have a nextCursor. For cultivar details, first call daylily.search_cultivars on the public index, then filter owned listings by cultivarReferenceId. Search unlinked or legacy listing titles with q or title. Use daylily.get_listing for private notes, images, and full detail. Requires OAuth.

cultivarReferenceId.description: Exact linked cultivar reference id. Use daylily.search_cultivars to find the id on the local public index, then filter owned listings.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous listing page. Keep the same filters.

hasPhoto.description: When true, only listings with uploaded listing photos. This does not mean the linked public cultivar reference has a photo.

hasPrice.description: When true, only listings with a positive price; when false, only listings without a positive price.

linkedToCultivar.description: When true, only listings linked to a cultivar; when false, only unlinked listings.

listId.description: Only listings that belong to this list id. If you only know the list name, call daylily.list_lists first.

q.description: Search owned listing title, description, and private note. Search cultivar details with daylily.search_cultivars, then filter here by cultivarReferenceId.

name: daylily.list_listings
title: List Listings
